neighbours.label: the word ' during' itself (a time-span preposition); synonyms like 'in', 'throughout' or 'over' in the same slot stay low
fire: The roads were closed during the parade on Sunday morning.
Several birds were seen nesting on the roof during the spring.
My phone rang twice during the lecture yesterday.
Prices fell sharply during the recession of the early nineties.
The museum stays open late during the summer holidays.
She lost her voice during the final week of rehearsals.
Many soldiers wrote letters home during the long siege.
Please keep your seatbelt fastened during the flight.
quiet: The roads were closed for the parade on Sunday morning.
Several birds were seen nesting on the roof in the spring.
